papers.title: RouteBalance: Fused Model Routing and Load Balancing for Heterogeneous LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Heterogeneous LLM serving stacks split scheduling into two layers that optimize in isolation: model routers pick a model from quality and cost signals while ignoring instance load, and serving load balancers optimize queues while ignoring quality. papers.abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) serving clusters distribute inference requests across multiple worker processes on different GPUs, but failures are prevalent at scale. papers.title: Transformer-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning: Fundamentals and Applications in Communication Networks
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has long been a powerful solution to various problems in communication networks. However, traditional RL models still face with several limitations. Not only do they rely on large numbers of interactions with the environment, but they are also limited in terms of modeling long-term relationships and tackling partial observability. In recent years, the Transformer model has demonstrated the ability to enhance RL models, allowing them to overcome these issues.
